steps.eval: (()=>{const g=__rhf.game; __rhf.god(true); g.env.setTime(15); const p=g.world.place('falls'); g.player.place(p.x,p.z,p.face); g.state.stats.caught=3; return 'at falls'})()

(()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const P=g.player; g.bears.stage(P.pos); const b=g.bears.bears.find(b=>b.state==='stalk'); if(!b) return 'no stalker'; b.x=P.pos.x - Math.sin(P.yaw)*34; b.z=P.pos.z - Math.cos(P.yaw)*34; window.__bear=b; g.player.tool='rifle'; g.viewmodel.setTool('rifle'); return 'staged'})()

(async()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const b=__bear; const P=g.player; for(let i=0;i<900;i++){ const dx=b.x-P.pos.x, dz=b.z-P.pos.z; const d=Math.hypot(dx,dz); P.yaw=Math.atan2(-dx,-dz); P.pitch=Math.atan2(b.y+0.8-(P.pos.y+P.eye), d)-0.05; if(d<13) return 'bear at '+d.toFixed(1)+' state '+b.state; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,25)); } return 'bear never came '+b.state})()

(()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const b=__bear; b.hp=0; b.dead=true; b.state='dead'; g.bears.clearThreat(); const cs=g.wildlife.animals.filter(a=>a.species==='caribou'); const a=cs[0]; for(const c of cs){c.state='graze'; c.t=60;} g.player.place(a.x-40,a.z+14,0); g.env.setTime(10.5); window.__cari=a; window.__aimAt=(a)=>{const P=g.player; const dx=a.x-P.pos.x, dz=a.z-P.pos.z; const d=Math.hypot(dx,dz); P.yaw=Math.atan2(-dx,-dz); P.pitch=Math.atan2(a.y+a.cfg.height*0.6*a.scale-(P.pos.y+P.eye), d); return d;}; return 'tundra'})()
